address: via Dante Alighieri 30/a, San Quirico d'Orcia, 53027, Italy
bio: In the heart of the pedestrian historic center, this venue offers a warm welcome in a rustic dining room or at a few tables overlooking the paseo. Family-run, it serves authentic Tuscan flavors prepared traditionally. The handmade pici with cherry tomatoes, olives, and slightly spicy anchovies are an unmissable summer delight!...
